About

Ferrand

DJ · Producer

Trance
Hard House
Hard Dance

Ferrand didn't choose music. Music chose him.

It started with the Tomorrowland 2012 aftermovie. Watched it more times than he can remember. Something about it, the scale, the feeling that music could actually do something to people, got under his skin. He was fourteen. A controller appeared under the Christmas tree. He started messing around with music software, not really knowing what he was doing.

By sixteen he was on the floors himself. Illegal raves in the woods, coloured lights and lasers through the trees, getting in with a fake stamp on your wrist. Dancing until it was light outside. Not thinking about making music. Just needing to be there.

The making part came later, quietly. One day he finished an edit of C'est Beau La Bourgeoisie, uploaded it without overthinking it. Just the excitement of putting something out, a small hope that maybe someone would hear it. People did. Then more people. Then hundreds of thousands of plays, without a label, without a plan.

He took detours through house and hip-hop before the new trance wave arrived and something clicked. Old Loveparade synths and pads, the rawness of early hard house, euphoria and grit in the same bar. Without really trying, he'd ended up exactly where he was always going.

His records have been picked up by Marlon Hoffstadt, KiKi, Armin van Buuren, Hannah Laing, Mischluft, 2Hot2Play and many more. He's played Lokschuppen Berlin, Grelle Forelle Vienna, Odonien and Artheater Cologne. Behind the decks he's not just playing bangers. He's building something. Tension, release, space to breathe. A journey that leaves the room wanting more.

He's not chasing anything. He's just making music for floors that didn't know they were waiting for it.
